text:
A sample of wax is heated. It begins to melt at 45°C and finishes melting at 49°C.
A sample of liquid is heated. It begins to boil at 141°C and remains at 141°C while it boils.
Which conclusion can be made from these results?
A
Both substances are impure.
B
Both substances are pure.
C
The wax is not a pure substance and the liquid is a pure substance.
D
The wax is a pure substance and the liquid is not a pure substance.

options.label: C
options.text: The wax is not a pure substance and the liquid is a pure substance.

options.label: D
options.text: The wax is a pure substance and the liquid is not a pure substance.
